userStories.title: Add confidence variance tracking to MatchResult
acceptanceCriteria: Add confidence_variance field to MatchResult in src/utils.py
Track variance of top-N candidate scores when multiple candidates have similar scores
Calculate variance as std_dev of top 5 candidate similarities in TieredMatcher
Add variance to match result JSON output in checkpoint
Add unit test in tests/test_confidence_variance.py verifying variance is calculated
Test that high variance (> 0.1) indicates uncertain match

userStories.title: Add semantic distance-based topic penalty
acceptanceCriteria: Update compute_topic_penalty in src/topic_extraction.py to use semantic similarity
Replace fixed -0.15 penalty with scaled penalty based on topic embedding distance
Use embedding model to compute topic similarity when LLM client available
Fall back to keyword overlap when embeddings unavailable
Add unit test in tests/test_topic_penalty_semantic.py for scaled penalty
Test that related topics (earthquake/disaster) get lower penalty than unrelated (earthquake/cooking)

Add quality metrics to checkpoint stages.match.quality_metrics

userStories.title: Add LLM reasoning quality validation

Add unit test in tests/test_temporal_coherence.py for coherence scoring
